messages.subject: Re: featureCounts 1.6.2 not allowing more than one thread
parts:
Thanks! I have received the SAM and GFF files.

I can reproduce the error; it looks like the large header in the SAM file caused the problem. This bug doesn't affect the BAM-format input. While we're fixing this bug, you can convert the SAM file into BAM format (by using Samtools view -Sb), then run featureCounts on the BAM-format input. The counting result should be identical to the result on the SAM file.
